rationale: The diff implements every step of the Implementation Plan with high fidelity: UiAutomator2Backend (uiautomator2_backend.dart) mirrors AppiumBackend's W3C transport and adds exactly the documented Android divergences (hierarchy XML parse with class->role map, bounds->rect, content-desc as tier-1 a11yId, resource-id-or-positional xpath synthesis, attribute/password-derived masked flag with attribute/text readback, POST /back keyboard dismiss, back/enter press keys, and NativeException for the iOS-only consent_accept/alert_dismiss keys). native_backend_factory.dart's backendForPlatform matches the plan verbatim (ios->AppiumBackend, android->UiAutomator2Backend, else ArgumentError, LOUD no fallback). leonard_native.dart gains exactly the two specified export lines. bin/leonard_native_host.dart swaps the direct AppiumBackend construction for backendForPlatform with an ArgumentError->exit(64) usage error, and updates the usage/doc text, per Step 4. The checked-in fixture (auth0_android_source.xml) matches the specified ten-control shape. Both unit test files (uiautomator2_backend_test.dart, native_backend_factory_test.dart) reproduce the designed test groups/assertions closely (parse ordering, Log in/Email/Password node checks, positional-xpath fallback, press vocabulary, masked-flag derivation). The hardware-gated Android Auth0 e2e (dogfood_auth0_android_e2e_test.dart) reproduces the plan's structure step-for-step: pm clear prep, up --platform android, observe->tap Log in by node_id, no consent_accept step, email/password enter_text with the Android masked/readback semantics, submit, the adaptive dismiss/authorize poll, the LOGGED_IN verdict assertion, and down/shutdown teardown — matching the design's stated Android divergences (no consent step, empty attribute/text on masked fields, pm clear instead of simctl uninstall). The root pubspec.yaml gets exactly the specified test:e2e:auth0:android melos script. All stated 'explicitly NOT touched' files (appium_backend.dart, native_extension.dart, native_perception.dart, native_snapshot.dart, leonard_agent/**, leonard_cli launcher/bin) are indeed absent from this bead's own commit set. Minor, non-substantive deviations only: commit-message wording differs slightly from the plan's suggested messages (e.g. 'feat(native): add the Android impl of the NativeBackend seam' vs the plan's 'feat(native): add UiAutomator2Backend — the Android impl of the NativeBackend seam'), and in-code doc comments drop the plan's specific line-number citations into native_backend.dart while keeping the same substantive content — neither changes behavior or outcome. Note: the pinned diff (origin/main...HEAD) also carries three earlier, unrelated commits (factoryskills removal, leonard_binding extensionsReady + profile-mode registration) that are outside this bead's Task/Design/Touches section entirely; they read as inherited stacked-branch history rather than scope drift introduced by this bead's own work, since none of the bead's acceptance criteria, design steps, or touches reference leonard_flutter or factoryskills.
